name: Spiritism
overview: The Bible firmly condemns spiritism, warning believers not to seek or consult those with familiar spirits or wizards, as doing so defiles and provokes God's judgment (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6, 27). God's people are instructed to avoid the abominable practices of surrounding nations, including spiritism, and instead seek the living God rather than the dead (Deuteronomy 18:9; Isaiah 8:19). Scripture also clarifies that the dead have no knowledge or reward, emphasizing the futility and danger of attempting to communicate with them (Ecclesiastes 9:5).
